subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: Which first-class A2A API shape should OpenClaw support for one-way dispatch without reply-back or announce?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but adding or changing model-facing session semantics affects compatibility, docs, tests, and existing peer coordination workflows.

options.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
options.body: Add a per-call `sessions_send` mode such as `mode: "dispatch"` that keeps the existing conversation behavior as the default.

options.title: Add a separate primitive
options.body: Introduce a new `sessions_deliver` or `sessions_enqueue` tool with one-way semantics, avoiding overloading `sessions_send`.

options.title: Defer to global ping-pong config
options.body: Leave `sessions_send` as conversation-only and document `agentToAgent.maxPingPongTurns=0`, accepting that it is not a per-send dispatch solution.

recommendation.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
recommendation.body: Add a per-call `sessions_send` mode such as `mode: "dispatch"` that keeps the existing conversation behavior as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: The current A2A/session-send behavior and recent split files are most strongly tied to this history trail.
